verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad first-party REST API surface covering expenses, payments, team, budgets, transactions and accounting, plus a quickstart, webhooks and an official MCP server, so its core operations can be driven programmatically without the UI. Documented automation recipes via Pipedream and Zapier show unattended workflows such as scheduled CSV exports and card issuance. However, nothing shows a CLI, CI-pipeline guidance, or service-account/token setup for headless runs, so the CI part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs, documented machine/service-account authentication for unattended use, hands-on corroboration.
